data.narrative:
Heaviside is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $28M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing, all operating in the same sector and stage.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $28M total raised as a proxy for post-money valuation and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implying $56M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations of $4.0B (Stark Defence), $400M (Singularity), and $125M (NODA AI). The median of this cohort is $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis produces a valuation range of $48M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $228M. This wide band reflects material dispersion within the Defense & Security peer set, driven primarily by Stark Defence's $4.0B valuation at the high end. Key uncertainties include whether Heaviside's technology, market position, and capital efficiency profile align more closely with the upper-quartile peers or the median cohort. Stage-progression alone ($56M) sits below the triangulated low end, suggesting capital raised alone does not fully capture sector-specific valuation dynamics at this stage.
